messages:
Riya S.: Quick thread: planning next sprint for Dedicated capacity enhancements. We need to finalize prioritization on 'momentary headroom' features (reserved-pool cushions, graceful spill, and autoscale gating). Listing the must-haves vs nice-to-haves.
Ben K.: Must-have: clear SLA behavior when cushion is used; must track cushion burn rate. Nice-to-have: customer-configurable cushion_pct.
Noah L.: Ops perspective: graceful spill should prefer throttling over preemption for predictable user experience. Also need per-pool emergency failover route.
Riya S.: Proposal: default cushion_pct=10%, cushion_window=300s, spill_to_shared=true, default_preempt=false. Customers on enterprise plans can opt into preemptive eviction.
Sasha M.: For launch criteria, add: detailed runbook for oncall, and post-launch 2-week ramp review. Also require telemetry: cushion_used_total, cushion_burn_rate, spill_events_count.
Ben K.: Simulations: I'll run two traffic models (periodic spikes, bursty Poisson) and send results. Target: <2% SLO violations across pilots.
OpsBot: Incident alert test scheduled for 2024-05-01 09:00 UTC.
Riya S.: Action items: Ben run sims, Noah draft runbook, Sasha assemble telemetry dashboard. We'll reconvene Wed. Thanks.
